answer: Quadratic staking collateral with slashing penalties scaled to the square of Sybil identity count forces super-linear capital expenditure: a cluster of n keys locks n²C, driving marginal attack cost above any extracted value horizon. The resulting robust Nash equilibrium sustains consensus whenever staked value exceeds the attacker's block-reward ember of extractable surplus.
